caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Oct 19–24 is here.

After 60, holding a bench and lifting one foot for 10–30 seconds is a simple way to start balance work. Desk-bound neck? Ten slow chin nods, 2–3 times a day, within comfort. A stiff ankle months after a sprain often responds to knee to wall rocks. And for back pain, walking for a time that's only mildly uncomfortable, split into 2–3 walks, can help.
